text:
Ivy L (AM): Heads-up: Solace Diagnostics wants to pilot in eu-west + brazil simultaneously next week. They requested EU-BR edge routing plus a 72h temporary rate uplift during the pilot ramp. Also asked for IP allowlist and a maintenance blackout during their live demos.
Noah G (cs-eng): Do we have expected peak qps and token burn? Any CIDRs yet?
Ivy L (AM): Customer provided numbers: steady 120 qps, ramp to 300 qps for first 72h. Token estimate ~90k/day. CIDRs: 18.142.0.0/16 (BR infra), 13.32.44.128/25 (eu-west CDN). They want 01:00-05:00 UTC blackout for platform updates during trial.
Kai M (onboard-eng): From product side we can route them to eu-west + br-edge pool and open a temp rate window. Need infra to add routes and front-door ACLs. Also suggest a soft cache-warmup pre-seed to reduce cold-start token spend.
Ivy L (AM): They'll accept a PO if pilot shows stable latency under burst. Renewal calendar: renewal in 12w; risk is medium-high until pilot completes. Please capture enablement feedback and get demo metrics.
Noah G (cs-eng): I'll create the runbook and monitoring checklist: watch p50/p95 latency, rate-limit hits, 5xxs, and token burn. Also flagging need to capture prompts that trigger high tokenization.
ops-bot: ticket created: INFRA-5028 "EU+BR edge routing + temp rate window for Solace Dx pilot" assigned to eng-infra. ETA 20h.
Kai M (onboard-eng): For eng-infra – small config snippet request:
```
- Add routes: 18.142.0.0/16 -> br-edge, 13.32.44.128/25 -> eu-west-edge
- Front-door allowlist: 18.142.0.0/16, 13.32.44.128/25
- Rate window: baseline 120 qps, burst 300 qps, duration 72h starting 2026-03-30T02:00:00Z
- Maintenance blackout: disallow platform rollouts/auto-maintenance between 01:00-05:00 UTC during pilot window
- Pre-seed cache: warm KV caches for their top 50 prefixes (contact Kai for list)
```
Noah G (cs-eng): Also request a soft auto-revert after 96h unless AM approves extension. Keep alerts for sudden token burn spikes.
infra-bot: INFRA-5028 updated: routing + ACL changes are routine. Maintenance blackout requires manual approval from infra-ops. No reserved capacity needed.
Ivy L (AM): I'll send the PO terms and schedule the 30m enablement + Q&A for day 1 post-launch. Add renewal check-in for week 6.
Noah G (cs-eng): I'll drop the runbook link in this thread once ready and ping support for on-call coverage during ramp.
Ivy L (AM): Thanks team. Tagging @eng-oncall in case anything pops during the 72h window. :pray:
Kai M (onboard-eng): Post-pilot: capture latency deltas per region, sample prompts that caused spikes, and a short NPS-style feedback from their engineers to feed into renewal materials.
ops-bot: INFRA-5028 status -> In progress (claimed by eng-infra). ETA 12h.
